description: This file defines an enum AnimationsLevel with three levels: Full, Some, and None. It includes a static method createPrefsObservable that creates an Observable to monitor animation level preferences combined with power-saving state, returning the appropriate AnimationsLevel based on user preferences and power-saving mode.

classes.name: AnimationsLevel
classes.description: Enum representing different levels of animations: Full, Some, and None.

methods.name: createPrefsObservable
methods.description: Creates an Observable that emits AnimationsLevel values based on user preferences and power-saving state.
